Line Leader Slicing - Meat Company | Oudenaarde | 2 Shifts

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.

As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.
The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

PROFIEL

Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

AANBOD

What do we offer you?

• We offer competitive and fair compensation, and there is no mandatory collective leave.
• You can schedule your time off as you wish.
• A quick start is possible.
• You’ll work on a weekly contract basis, and after a successful temporary assignment, you’ll be offered a permanent contract.

Jobomschrijving

• 

Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination: Lead and support a team of two finance administrators while coordinating with external service providers and stakeholders responsible for the financial administration of international entities.
• 

Accounting & Payment Oversight: Prepare and review complex accounting entries, ensuring accuracy and compliance, while overseeing banking transactions and payment processes.

You must have/be:

TPCE (Toyota Parts Centre Europe) is het Europees Distributiecentrum van Toyota. Het levert Toyota & Lexus– onderdelen aan Europese distributeurs. Verder belevert Toyota ook rechtstreeks aan garages/dealers in België, Luxemburg, Nederland, Duitsland en Noord – Frankrijk. In Diest worden de ingevoerde auto – onderdelen van Toyota en Lexus gestockeerd en worden de bestellingen voor de dealers en distributeurs klaargemaakt en verzonden. TPCE is een geautomatiseerd verdeelcentrum van auto – onderdelen.

Jobomschrijving

Tasks & Responsibilities

• Monitor supplier compliance with the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
• Track project progress and ensure deadlines are met.
• Organize and facilitate online meetings with suppliers.
• Explain PPWR requirements, compliance expectations, and supplier responsibilities.
• Discuss and clarify different packaging types and packaging processes.
• Coordinate implementation plans and define target dates.
• Follow up on corrective actions and ensure timely execution.
• Monitor progress, milestones, and supplier commitments.
• Prepare weekly compliance reports for management.
• Identify risks, bottlenecks, and areas requiring escalation.
• Conduct audits and inspections within warehouse operations.
• Verify manufacturer labels and packaging compliance.
• Ensure packaging and labeling processes meet PPWR requirements and internal standards.
• Collaborate with internal departments and external suppliers.
• Contribute to a sustainable, compliant, and efficient supply chain.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization projects.

Profile

• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
• Experience with sustainable packaging solutions is an asset.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and SharePoint.
• Knowledge of Access and Power BI is a plus.
• Able to manage multiple suppliers, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
• Strong planning, organizational, and prioritization skills.
• Accurate, structured, and detail-oriented.
• Able to work independently while maintaining a proactive approach.
• Analytical and capable of making fact-based decisions.
• Strong follow-up skills and a results-driven mindset.
• Positive attitude combined with a strong work ethic.
• Team player who values collaboration and respect.
• Eager to learn and continuously improve processes.

Employees benefit from a dynamic working environment where knowledge sharing, professional growth and teamwork are highly valued, creating opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.

Jobomschrijving

• Partner with management to identify training needs and develop tailored learning solutions.

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. To support its continued growth and customer-centric strategy, the company is looking for a Customer Experience Representative to strengthen its EMEA Sales & Operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Experience Representative, you will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of B2B customers and play a key role in delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Working closely with sales, operations, logistics and finance teams, you will ensure smooth order processing while proactively supporting commercial activities and continuous improvement initiatives.Customer Relationship Management

• Manage and follow up a dedicated portfolio of customers across the EMEA region.
• Act as the first point of contact for customer inquiries and service-related matters.
• Build strong customer relationships and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Handle customer claims, returns and complaints professionally and efficiently.
• Gather relevant customer and market feedback and share insights internally.

Order Management & Sales Support

• Manage the complete order-to-delivery process.
• Follow up on orders, backorders and delivery schedules.
• Prepare and follow up quotations in collaboration with the Account Managers.
• Provide customers with accurate information regarding pricing, lead times and product availability.
• Support the sales pipeline and contribute to achieving business targets.
• Monitor service performance and customer agreements.

Process Improvement & Operations

• Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and operational efficiency.
• Collaborate closely with logistics and operations teams to optimize transport, packaging and order flows.
• Contribute to digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and quality standards.

Financial Follow-up

• Support the monitoring of outstanding customer payments.
• Collaborate with finance teams regarding credit limits, payment conditions and invoice-related matters.

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management or Inside Sales.
• Experience within an international B2B environment is a strong plus.
• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP is an advantage).
• Fluent Dutch and English
• Proactive and able to work autonomously.

Our client is a fast-growing organization active in the financial services sector. As part of its continued expansion, the company is investing heavily in digital transformation initiatives aimed at harmonizing processes, improving operational efficiency, and supporting the adoption of innovative technologies, including AI.

Jobomschrijving

As a Business Analyst, you will play a key role in the group's digital transformation journey. Working closely with business stakeholders and digital teams, you will analyze existing ways of working, identify improvement opportunities, and support the implementation of new tools and processes across multiple entities.

This position is ideal for someone with a background in accounting or finance who has developed a strong interest in technology, process optimization, and digital transformation.

Key responsibilities

• Analyze and document business processes across different entities.
• Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and automation.
• Gather and challenge business requirements from key stakeholders.
• Act as the bridge between end-users, operational teams, and digital experts.
• Support the implementation and adoption of new digital solutions.
• Drive change management and promote best practices across the organization.
• Help users leverage new technologies and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.
• Provide training and guidance to internal teams on digital tools and new ways of working.
• Monitor user feedback and propose continuous improvements.

• 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Functional Analyst or Digital Transformation Consultant.
• Alternatively, experience in accounting combined with strong exposure to digital tools and process improvement.
• Knowledge of accounting and financial workflows.
• Familiarity with accounting software or digital finance solutions is a strong advantage.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Curious about technology, AI, and innovation.
• Hands-on mindset and willingness to work in a fast-growing environment.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.

While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.

To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.

The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.

One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.

We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.

As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.

The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.

To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Head of Network Infrastructure.

The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Network Infrastructure, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.

Infrastructure & Network Strategy

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
• Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
• Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
• Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.

Service Ownership & Operations

• Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
• Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
• Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.

Security & Risk Management

• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
• Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
• Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
• Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
• Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.

Leadership

• Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
• Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.

Experience

• Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
• Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
• Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
• Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.

Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
• Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
• Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
• Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
• Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.

Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
• Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.

Languages skills 

• English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
• French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.

Our client is a global market leader operating within complex international supply chains. From a strategic logistics hub in Belgium, the company manages large-scale transportation flows across Europe and continues to invest in the growth of its rail logistics operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate and monitor daily rail transportation activities across Europe.
• Manage transport disruptions, delays, and operational escalations.
• Act as the main point of contact between internal stakeholders and external transport partners.
• Monitor wagon availability, utilization, and transport capacity.
• Support sourcing of additional transport capacity when required.
• Prepare operational reports and track logistics KPIs.
• Follow up transport costs, documentation, and invoicing processes.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Initial experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or a related field is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data and Excel.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable operating in a dynamic international environment.
• Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.

This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.

Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.
